- verify_failed: src/engine.ts(224,79): error TS2353: Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'shape' does not exist in type 'Impulse'. | src/engine.ts(226,83): error TS2353: Object literal may only spec

Do not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above.
